regulations.title: Wildfire Emergency Capacity Flexibilities Expired: Over-Capacity Audit Warning
regulations.summary: Emergency capacity expansions and expedited intake provisions enacted during regional wildfire evacuations have officially concluded. Operating beyond licensed bed capacity (6 or 8 beds) under expired emergency provisions subjects facilities to immediate DSHS RCS unannounced inspection citations, Class A civil fines, and Stop-Placement orders.
regulations.action: Reconcile resident census against licensed capacity immediately.

regulations.title: Q4 Direct Care Staff Dementia & Mental Health Training Compliance
regulations.summary: Facilities with specialty endorsements must verify all newly hired caregivers complete state-approved specialty curricula within 120 days of hire and file certificates in personnel files for surveyor audit.

regulations.title: Subcutaneous Insulin & Gastrostomy Tube Nurse Delegation Annual Review
regulations.summary: Verify sliding-scale insulin orders and RN delegation supervisory logs are current to eliminate unauthorized nursing practice citations and retrospective Medicaid reimbursement clawbacks.

privacy_policy.collects: Preliminary health care inquiry details, hospital discharge summaries, Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), and contact information submitted by seniors, family representatives, and hospital discharge planners.
privacy_policy.processing: Used to match with licensed Adult Family Homes in Thurston, Lewis, and Mason counties. The page states Anthropic Claude API is used under enterprise Zero Data Retention and a Business Associate Agreement, and that clinical data is not used to train foundation models.
privacy_policy.sharing: Not sold, rented, or traded. Shared only with prospective licensed Adult Family Homes with explicit client consent.

terms.service: Senior care housing referral, placement advisory, and matching under RCW 18.330.
terms.fees: Free to seniors and families. Placement fees paid by the receiving Adult Family Home. No fee when Medicaid or public assistance pays in whole or in part.
terms.scope: Advisory only. Does not provide direct healthcare, nursing, or medical services. The senior or their legal representative chooses the home.
